infoText: “Beware：my shackles fall with the heads of the condemned.”

"Good of you to show up, Hero.
 I will at least commend your bravery."
"You're already here, Hero!? I-I will commend you for that."

"If you surrender, I'll book Eli-chan's
 solo concert to go on a world tour."

Dark Lan's Admonition： "Don't stay in one place! Move as you will!"
